title: Call Center: Meter Reading '0.00' on Maple Street

fields.systemName: Call Center Voice Recorder - Central Console

transcript.speaker: Rivera, Agent
transcript.text: Control, this is Agent Rivera from the call center. We’ve just received a call from a customer at 104 Maple Street. They say their meter has been reading '0.00' for three days and they haven’t had gas since. The meter is a SmartGas-3000 model, and the last reading was 1.2 MCF on 03/20. Is this a new outage or a meter failure? The customer says they’ve tried turning the valve on and off but no gas comes out. We’ve already sent a serviceperson, but they’re not on the map yet.

transcript.speaker: GCM, Gas Control Manager
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm the meter location is within Pressure District 7. Hold the customer until a technician confirms the valve is closed downstream. No further action needed at this time.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The meter reading is normal under overpressure conditions.
